prOriginal.nota: Title differs ('Feature flag: rolling-updates'); found by searching the benchmark head SHA. PR headRefOid equals the benchmark head 62bf9893 (merge commit 0f91e67b); the benchmark diff vs base also carries unrelated main-branch changes, but the PR's own files match.

add-rolling-updates-feature-flag-and-com.reason: PR #36946 removed the separate feature guards from UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run() and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.run() and put a single guard in the shared AbstractUpdatesCommand.run(), so the independent untested check-subcommand guard no longer existed and the metadata test exercised the shared guard; testFeatureNotEnabled itself was not changed. PR #46133 (2026-02-16) later deleted the guard and the test entirely; today UpdateCommandDistTest is gone from that path and there is no feature guard.

astra.pergunta: Descontinuado, and is the removal #36946 (guard consolidated into shared base run()) or #46133 (guard removed entirely)?
astra.resposta: Descontinuado with #36946: it removed the independent check guard and replaced both copies with one inherited run() whose guard the metadata test exercises; #46133 came after the gap had already ceased.

add-rolling-updates-feature-flag-and-com.reason: Through every revision until 2026-02 (including #38661 'ensuring exit codes are handled consistently'), testFeatureNotEnabled only called cliResult.assertError(...) and never asserted the FEATURE_DISABLED exit code (4). PR #46133 made rolling-updates:v2 a default/essential feature and deleted the feature-disabled guard, its exit code and testFeatureNotEnabled, without adding an exit-code assertion, so the behaviour under test no longer exists.
